newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish narrowly mixed, off lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish narrowly mixed, off lows.

text.p: Aug 15 - U.S. debt futures ended narrowly mixed in quiet trade, up from early lows. Traders said market local-dominated in last hour, quiet overall. "After a rough and tumble week we took it easy today," a bond trader said. Traders note that afternoon bond rally from low coincided with stock sell-off, though traders said they didn't see outright asset allocation. FOMC meets Tuesday.
